A couple of things that really help:
- Peak concurrent QPS or percentiles (p95/p99)
- Average request length in tokens and expected max sequence lengths
- Expected growth (linear % month-over-month)

Rough rule-of-thumb we'll cover: Dedicated sizing often depends more on p99 latency and peak concurrency. For example, a 16-GPU Dedicated pool can support ~X concurrent sessions at Y latency for small tokens; we'll demonstrate with your numbers.

I'll prepare a short capacity slide to walk through the math.
